rows.label: qst701104_msg0001
rows.name:
Ah, everyone! Thank you so
much for your help back then.

rows.label: qst701104_msg0002
rows.name:
...Reinforced glass? Of course, I
handle that. Please wait a moment.

rows.label: qst701104_msg0003
rows.name:
Please take this. Ah...
there's no charge.

rows.label: qst701104_msg0004
rows.name:
Thanks to you, I can still make glass,
so please let me at least give you
this little extra for free.

rows.label: qst701104_msg0005
rows.name:
If you'd like, please come visit again
anytime. Even if it has nothing
to do with... glass.
